body: The pair is streaked with clouded sample jar from treated rows. It was set aside after the flies vanished, before anyone marked the coat pocket unsafe.
title: Clouded sample jar by the coat pocket
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

body: The battery is taped into the radio with a strip cut from a medicine label. The dial is fixed in place. The clinic kept a receiver ready on one frequency even after ordinary broadcasts had stopped.
title: A dial that cannot turn
gloss: A personal account or object records an intervention that left part of the account missing.
rival_reading: The receiver may have been set to hear warnings about an agricultural release.
